description: This file contains utility functions for reading files into memory and printing their contents, primarily used in unit tests as indicated by the filename ut_test_common.c. It includes functions to open files, determine size, allocate buffer, read contents, and print data for testing purposes.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer provided via a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling file opening, size determination, memory allocation, and reading.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file and a provided key-value pair string, utilizing the read_file_into_memory function to load file contents for display.
